data: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf is a 27B parameter text generation model optimized for on-device inference using llama.cpp. It achieves ~98.2% of FP16 intelligence with a drastically reduced ~5.9 GB footprint by employing end-to-end ternary transformer weights (1.72 bits/weight), enabling efficient reasoning and long context (262K tokens) on consumer hardware with CUDA and Metal support.
